verdict.rationale: The GeForce RTX 5090 is a consumer graphics card, so issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials to an agent is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any credential or API-key system; the CUDA, DLSS and NGC items cover GPU compute and rendering, not access control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
